Behind every result,

Three businesses. Three ways to reduce day-to-day work and keep customer relationships moving. See what Nintec360 handles and what changes for the team.

Real estate ↓Retail ↓Restaurants ↓

REAL ESTATE

Every enquiry answered.
Every opportunity moving forward.

CASE RESULTS

100%of enquiries handled

+20%in sales

THE REAL PROBLEM

Out-of-hours enquiries, repetitive questions and opportunities at risk of going unanswered. Coordination between agents was manual.

CallsWhatsApp→Awaiting a reply

WHAT CHANGES FOR THE TEAM

Less coordination.
More time to sell.

  • Enquiries are answered and move towards a viewing.
  • The agent understands the customer’s interest before they meet.
  • The team spends less time on repetitive questions and tasks.

Answering every enquiry and following up keeps opportunities from stalling. In this case: every enquiry handled and more sales.

RETAIL · MATTRESSES

The sale no longer ends
when the customer leaves the store.

CASE RESULTS

+40%in positive reviews

+25%in revenue

THE REAL PROBLEM

Conversations were scattered across stores. After the sale, the customer relationship lacked continuity.

Disconnected stores→Relationship interrupted

WHAT CHANGES FOR THE TEAM

An ongoing relationship.
More reasons to return.

  • From conversation to online purchase, with context shared across stores.
  • Follow-up and satisfaction checks after purchase.
  • Customers re-engaged based on their interests and history.

Follow-up encourages reviews, while re-engagement creates fresh opportunities to buy. That continuity is reflected in both results for this case.

CASE RESULT

THE REAL PROBLEM

WHAT CHANGES FOR THE TEAM

Staff spend less time taking, confirming and routing orders. The system’s handling of that work accounts for the savings in this case.
